subject: error message in spatio-temporal barrier model

messages.author: 8b9a193f27c3b019
messages.subject: error message in spatio-temporal barrier model
parts:
Hi INLA Groups,

I analyze the spatio-temporal change in occurrence rate of coastal species using barrier model, and have an error message in inla().
Could you tell me the solution of below error message?

For your information, spatial barrier model (i.e., not contained time effect) run successfully.

Thanks in advance.
All the best,
YK

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# data including presence/absence, lon, lat, year (t = 1~3), timestep (1 is t, 2 is t+1,,, for group in inla.spde.naje.A()). 
temp = read.csv() #nrow = 20558

# without terrestrial area
mesh <- inla.mesh.2d(boundary = poly.water,
                     max.edge = 0.5,
                     cutoff = 0.2,
                     offset = c(1, 1))

barrier.model <- inla.barrier.pcmatern(mesh, 
                                       barrier.triangles = barrier.tri)
Q <- inla.rgeneric.q(barrier.model, "Q", theta = c(0, log(range)))

iset = inla.spde.make.index("i", n.spde = barrier.model$f$n, n.group = length(unique(temp$timestep)))

loc = as.matrix(cbind(temp$lon, temp$lat))

# projector matrix
A = inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc = loc, group = temp$time)
dim(A) #20558, 5214


# for prediction
coop = coop[which(ind == 1), ] # nrow = 1518
Ap = inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, loc = coop, group = length(unique(temp$time)))
dim(Ap) # 1518, 5214


stk = inla.stack(
  data = list(y = catch),
  A = list(A, 1),
  effects = list(iset, intercept = rep(1, length(temp$presence))),
  tag = 'est'
)

na = rep(NA, nrow(coop))
stk.pred = inla.stack(
  data = list(y = na),
  A = list(Ap, 1),
  effects = list(iset, intercept = rep(1, nrow(coop))),
  tag = 'pred'
)
joint.stk = inla.stack(stk, stk.pred)


form.barrier = y ~ 0 + intercept + f(i, model = barrier.model, group = iset$i.group, control.group = list(model = "ar1"))

res = inla(form.barrier, data = inla.stack.data(joint.stk),
           control.predictor = list(A = inla.stack.A(joint.stk)),
           family = 'binomial', 
           control.inla = list(int.strategy = "eb"),
           control.compute = list(waic = TRUE, dic = TRUE))

### error message###
inla(form.barrier, data = inla.stack.data(joint.stk), control.predictor = list(A = inla.stack.A(joint.stk)), : 
length(group) != length(xx) 5214 != 1419
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] error message in spatio-temporal barrier model
parts:
In your group= argument, remove iset$, to make it group=i.group

Finn
